method.constraints: constraint rows as added by polyis/sample/ilp/c/gurobi.pyx, before presolve and including duplicates: per tile covered in >= 2 frames, 2 equalities (first, last), and per consecutive covering pair 2 equalities if the gap exceeds the tile max distance (max_rate_table // sample_rate, >= 1) else 1 window constraint
method.correlations: Spearman with average ranks. Pooled correlations mix datasets and sample rates; correlation_within_strata gives the within dataset x sample rate values (strata with >= 30 instances). s = 1 solve times are censored by the budget and s >= 4 ones sit at the fixed overhead floor
method.deciles: equal-count bins of variables per split, pooled over datasets and sample rates (confounded; see each bin's instances_by_sample_rate and instances_by_dataset)
method.distinct_constraints: distinct rows: distinct forced variables plus distinct (current variable, window variables) window constraints
method.forced_variables: distinct variables fixed to 1 by equality constraints
method.input: 020_relevancy scores binarized at relevance_threshold, grouped by group_tiles_all with TILEPADDING_MODE 0 (4-connected polyominoes)
method.instances: every complete 022_pruned_polyominoes output in the cache that is in the split's expected set; no sampling
method.nonzeros: 1 per equality, window size + 1 per window constraint (distinct_nonzeros over distinct rows)
method.operating_points: fastest validated configuration within 5% of the reference test HOTA, and the fastest that prunes, as in r9o3_ilp_timings extraction_share.json
method.polyominoes_per_frame: pooled over the sampled frames of every instance; bound ceil(rows * cols / 2)
method.quantiles: median interpolated; p95 of counts is an observed value (quantile_disc), p95 of times interpolated
method.rules: current p022: score > r * 255; floor (what the April 2026 cache matches): score >= floor(r * 255); each instance uses the rule its saved selection is consistent with (checks.json solutions, rule_* counts)
method.solve_at_budget: estimate: solve_ms >= 1000 * budget_s, budget = time_limit or 0.1 s; Gurobi termination status is not logged, so a slow optimal solve also counts (budget_sensitivity)
method.test: validated (Pareto) Tetris configurations that run the ILP, on every test video; other test outputs excluded (checks.json coverage)
method.timings: p022 runtime.jsonl via common.load_prune_runs: build_ilp (includes Gurobi env start) and solve_ilp (includes solution read and env release)
method.unit: an instance is one (clip, ILP configuration) pair; pooled rows weight datasets by videos x configurations and mix sample rates, so cite level dataset_sample_rate or operating_points
method.valid: every configuration p022 left on the validation videos; not a complete video x configuration grid on every dataset (checks.json coverage missing_instances)
method.variables: one binary per polyomino per sampled frame, summed over the clip
